a.description: array of values to be binned. May be any size or dimension.

bins.description: Specify the number of bins in the histogram (default: 10). ``bins`` may also be an array specifying the locations of the bin edges.

range.description: tuple of scalars. Specifies the range of the data. If not specified, the range is inferred from the data.

weights.description: An optional array specifying the weights of the data points. Should be broadcast-compatible with ``a``. If not specified, each data point is weighted equally.

density.description: If True, return the normalized histogram in units of counts per unit length. If False (default) return the (weighted) counts per bin.

output.description: A tuple of arrays ``(histogram, bin_edges)``, where ``histogram`` contains the aggregated data, and ``bin_edges`` specifies the boundaries of the bins.
